title: Adjusted remittance on a line with coinsurance
assertion: `approved` for the payer's payment increase, posted and deposited net of the payment it replaced, and recovered; the patient's share shown as billable to the patient, counted in no total; a later reversal `recouped` for what was paid, and a reissue after it `approved` for its payment over the original; a partial check-level posting proves the line's share net of the payment it replaced; a lower reprocessing in the same reconcile takes back the payment decrease

files.description: The original payment: 97110 x 2 allowed 70.00 against an expected 100.00 (a case line), CO-45 80.00, PR-2 coinsurance 14.00, paid 56.00.
The adjusted remittance: the original reversed (PR-2 -14.00, paid -56.00) and the correction allowed 100.00, CO-45 50.00, PR-2 coinsurance 20.00, paid 80.00: BPR02 24.00.
A posting export with line detail: one row posting the correction’s 80.00 on its 2026-03-09 line, the gross payment.
A posting export with one check-level row posting the adjusted check, 24.00.
The bank export: one deposit of 24.00 matched by trace number and amount.
The correction reversed alone (PR-2 -20.00, paid -80.00) beside another patient's claim paying 150.00: BPR02 70.00.
After the reversal, a reissue allowed 75.00, CO-45 75.00, PR-2 coinsurance 15.00, paid 60.00: BPR02 60.00.
The adjusted remittance's reversal and correction beside another patient's claim paying 150.00: BPR02 174.00 (loaded in place of adjusted.835).
A posting export with one check-level row posting part of the shared check, 87.00 of 174.00, no line detail.
A lower reprocessing: the correction reversed and paid again allowed 87.50, CO-45 62.50, PR-2 coinsurance 17.50, paid 70.00, beside another patient's claim paying 150.00: BPR02 140.00.

Another patient's original payment (its own case line), the coinsurance at the claim's level: 97110 x 2 allowed 70.00 (AMT B6), CO-45 80.00 and SVC03 70.00 on the line, the claim's PR-2 coinsurance 14.00, CLP04 56.00.

Its adjusted remittance: the original reversed (the claim's PR-2 -14.00, CLP04 -56.00) and the correction allowed 100.00, CO-45 50.00 and SVC03 100.00 on the line, the claim's PR-2 coinsurance 20.00, CLP04 80.00: BPR02 24.00.
The bank export of that check: one deposit of 24.00 matched by trace number and amount.
A claim under a new claim control number with no REF F8, found by patient control number, service date and code: allowed 100.00, CO-45 50.00, PR-2 coinsurance 20.00, paid 80.00: BPR02 80.00.
Paid later, the original reversed (paid -56.00) and its correction, found by claim control number, allowed 87.50, CO-45 62.50, PR-2 coinsurance 17.50, paid 70.00: BPR02 14.00.
A later remittance whose PLB WO takes back 10.00 against the correction (SYNCCNLED140002), beside another patient's claim paying 150.00: BPR02 140.00.
Then the correction reversed (paid -80.00) and reissued allowed 110.00, CO-45 40.00, PR-2 coinsurance 22.00, paid 88.00: BPR02 8.00.
After the lower reprocessing, it reversed (paid -70.00) and paid again allowed 100.00, CO-45 50.00, PR-2 coinsurance 20.00, paid 80.00, beside another patient's claim paying 150.00: BPR02 160.00.
After the reversal, a reissue at the original's amounts: allowed 70.00, CO-45 80.00, PR-2 coinsurance 14.00, paid 56.00: BPR02 56.00.
Then that reissue reversed (paid -56.00) and paid again allowed 60.00, CO-45 90.00, PR-2 coinsurance 12.00, paid 48.00, beside another patient's claim paying 150.00: BPR02 142.00.
